Maya (AE): Heads-up — NovaRetail wants a focused perf run for their odd traffic: very short sessions (1-3s), repeat microbursts ~250 qps for 20-45s, then long idle. They need p50/p95/p99, error rates, and cost guidance. Also KMS requirements. Can SE+Eng propose a run and quick cost delta vs reserved?
Sam (SE): Yep. Quick clarifying q's: model family? open-13b or similar? Prompt+resp ~200 tokens total? Streaming needed?
Maya (AE): They said open-13b-ish, ~200 tokens. Streaming OK but not required. Wants cold vs primed comparison too.
Sam (SE): Proposed bench plan: 1) cold-start burst: no warmup, 45s @150 qps 2) priming: 5m warm at 50 qps to populate KV/prefix cache 3) burst sweep: five bursts 45s each at [50,100,150,200,250] qps with 3m idle between 4) capture p50/p95/p99, errors, GPU util, tokens/sec.
Sam (SE): Minimal harness example:
```bash
./microbench --endpoint https://api.redwood/v1/generate \
  --model open-13b-q4f32 --seq 200 --burst "45s@250" --repeat 5 --out metrics.json
```
Sam (SE): Or use wrk with a microburst script if they want HTTP-level probe.
Devon (Eng): Runtime config suggestions: prefix_cache.enabled=true, prefix_cache.size_mb=256, batch.max_tokens=2048, batch.time_ms=8, async_kv_prefetch=true. Enable autoscale.burst_policy with cooldown 120s. For Dedicated recommend small reserved pool + 2x burst buffer for short spikes.
Devon (Eng): Example quick-run notes from our infra (for reference): burst 30s @250 qps => p50 ~82ms, p95 ~220ms, p99 ~430ms, errors 0.3%, GPU util ~76%. Cold-start first burst p95 moved to ~540ms and errors rose to ~1.6%.
Priya (Security): KMS: they asked HSM-backed keys and per-tenant rotation. Private/Dedicated support HSM (cloud KMS or YubiHSM). Need to confirm whether they require offline wrapping or specific rotation cadence and IP allowlist for load generator. If Fed-like controls are needed, note Private deploy + audit retention will change cost and schedule.
Maya (AE): Pricing ask: Tom — what's the incremental cost for this bursty pattern vs standard per-token?
Sam (SE): Back-of-envelope: hosted per-1k tokens example ~$0.12. Bursty without reserved leads to ~1.2-1.7x effective cost due to idle and warmup inefficiency. With small Dedicated/reserved pool sized for steady+25% headroom, delta drops to ~1.05-1.25x. I'll make a toy cost table after we pick cluster sizes.
Tom (Prospect): We can give two 2-hour windows this week. Want cold vs warm comparisons and a short runbook for our infra team. Also confirm whether secrets stay in our KMS.
Sam (SE): We'll do: cold burst, primed burst, burst sweep. We'll export CSVs of latencies and a short runbook. For KMS, if Private/Dedicated we can integrate with your KMS/HSM; hosted needs key wrapping options — Priya will detail.
Devon (Eng): Prep checklist: 1) confirm model artifact and variant (quantized level) 2) provide IPs for load generator allowlist 3) grant token with limited scope 4) pick run window. We'll run one warmup then scripted bursts.
Maya (AE): Tom booked Wednesday 10am PST. Sam/Devon can you confirm harness and I'll send invite + pre-run checklist?
Sam (SE): Confirmed — will attach harness and a minimal runbook after this thread.
